svg.title: opusfleet — system architecture
svg.text: — Opus audio from a device fleet, split along Kafka
Ingest parses and produces; decoding, segmenting and serving each scale on their own. Every box below runs as a container.
≈ 8 KB/s on the wire per device
RTP seq survives into every consumer,
A slow upload can no longer
retention capped by time and bytes
decodes only what is being watched
holds no state — rebuilds it from
ingest and the non-decoding consumers held zero lag; only decode needed replicas.
